connection_condition: atom.molecule_id names the molecule that the atom belongs to; an atom cannot exist without its molecule
description: A molecule is composed of the atoms recorded against it.

connection_condition: bond.molecule_id names the molecule that the bond belongs to; a bond cannot exist without its molecule
description: A molecule is composed of the bonds recorded against it.

connection_condition: the two atoms recorded for a bond in the connectivity relation are the atoms the bond connects
description: A bond is composed of the two atoms it links; the pair of atoms is what defines the bond.
Carcinogenic molecules are a subclass of molecules: every carcinogenic molecule is a molecule, and its identifier set is a subset of the molecule identifier domain.
Non-carcinogenic molecules are a subclass of molecules: every non-carcinogenic molecule is a molecule, and its identifier set is a subset of the molecule identifier domain.
A single bond is one of the three bond types; the single-bond population is a subset of all bonds.
A double bond is one of the three bond types; the double-bond population is a subset of all bonds.
A triple bond is one of the three bond types; the triple-bond population is a subset of all bonds.

connection_condition: the referencing values recorded on atom and bond records belong to the same identifier space as the molecule identifiers
description: The molecule identifier used as a reference on atoms and bonds and the molecule identifier of the molecule itself denote the same compounds; a molecule can be reached from its atoms and bonds through this shared identifier.

connection_condition: each atom carries exactly one element value
description: An atom is characterized by its chemical element; the element is a property of the atom rather than a separate entity, and there is no element dimension table.

connection_condition: each bond records one bond type symbol, except one bond that records none
description: A bond is characterized by its bond type; the type is a property of the bond rather than a separate entity.

connection_condition: each molecule that is classified records one label symbol
description: A molecule carries a carcinogenicity classification used to partition molecules into carcinogenic and non-carcinogenic populations.

connection_condition: both atom roles of a connectivity row reference atoms of the same molecule
description: The connectivity fact relates an atom to a partner atom through a shared bond; it is the only path from a bond to the atoms it connects.
The element occurrence share is derived from the count of atoms carrying the specified element and the total atom count of the same molecule population.
The average number of bonds per atom is derived from the bond incidences recorded for a population of atoms and the number of distinct atoms in that population.
